title: Rosacea
caption: Rosacea is a chronic skin condition that causes persistent redness, visible blood vessels, and sometimes acne-like bumps — but it's not acne, and treating it like acne usually makes it worse. It works by a combination of an overactive immune response and heightened blood vessel sensitivity, which is why heat, sun, spice, and alcohol tend to flare it. In the Gulf, AC transitions and intense UV are two of the most common triggers. Knowing that rosacea is a sensitivity condition — not a hygiene or breakout problem — changes which ingredients and environments you actually need to watch. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
